The background sync that keeps this computer up to date.

See [Background sync](/cli/background-sync/) for how it runs on each system.

## Usage

```sh
skillpouch daemon <COMMAND>
```

## Commands

| Command                    | What it does                                      |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `skillpouch daemon start`  | Start it, and start it again whenever you log in. |
| `skillpouch daemon stop`   | Stop it.                                          |
| `skillpouch daemon status` | Is it running, and how did the last sync go?      |
